brine.name: brine

brine.flavorText: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

last-resort.name: last-resort
last-resort.effect: Can only be used after all of the user’s other moves have been used.
last-resort.flavorText: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

sucker-punch.name: sucker-punch
sucker-punch.effect: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
sucker-punch.flavorText: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

dragon-rush.name: dragon-rush
dragon-rush.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
dragon-rush.flavorText: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.

draco-meteor.name: draco-meteor
draco-meteor.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
draco-meteor.flavorText: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

double-hit.name: double-hit
double-hit.flavorText: The user slams the foe with a tail, etc. The target is hit twice in a row.

scald.name: scald
scald.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
scald.flavorText: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

hex.name: hex
hex.effect: Has double power if the target has a major status ailment.
hex.flavorText: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.

dragon-tail.name: dragon-tail
dragon-tail.effect: Ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
dragon-tail.flavorText: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

phantom-force.name: phantom-force
phantom-force.effect: User vanishes, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.  Hits through Protect and Detect.
phantom-force.flavorText: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

psychic-fangs.name: psychic-fangs
psychic-fangs.flavorText: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

dragon-darts.name: dragon-darts
dragon-darts.flavorText: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each target once.

breaking-swipe.name: breaking-swipe
breaking-swipe.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
breaking-swipe.flavorText: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

tera-blast.name: tera-blast
tera-blast.flavorText: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

pounce.name: pounce
pounce.flavorText: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

dragon-cheer.name: dragon-cheer
dragon-cheer.flavorText: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

pound.name: pound
pound.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
pound.flavorText: Pounds with fore­ legs or tail.

jump-kick.name: jump-kick
jump-kick.effect: If the user misses, it takes half the damage it would have inflicted in recoil.

ice-beam.name: ice-beam
ice-beam.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
ice-beam.flavorText: An attack that may freeze the foe.

blizzard.name: blizzard
blizzard.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
blizzard.flavorText: An attack that may freeze the foe.

low-kick.name: low-kick
low-kick.effect: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.
low-kick.flavorText: An attack that may cause flinching.

defense-curl.name: defense-curl
defense-curl.effect: Raises user’s Defense by one stage.

high-jump-kick.name: high-jump-kick
high-jump-kick.effect: If the user misses, it takes half the damage it would have inflicted in recoil.
high-jump-kick.flavorText: May miss and hurt the user.

dizzy-punch.name: dizzy-punch
dizzy-punch.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
dizzy-punch.flavorText: An attack that may cause confusion.

charm.name: charm
charm.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

heal-bell.name: heal-bell
heal-bell.effect: Cures the entire party of major status effects.

mirror-coat.name: mirror-coat
mirror-coat.effect: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last special hit it took.
mirror-coat.flavorText: Counters a SPCL. ATK. move double.

uproar.name: uproar
uproar.effect: Forced to use this move for several turns.  Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.
uproar.flavorText: Causes an uproar for 2 to 5 turns and prevents sleep.

hyper-voice.name: hyper-voice
hyper-voice.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
hyper-voice.flavorText: A loud attack that uses sound waves to injure.

bounce.name: bounce
bounce.effect: User bounces high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
bounce.flavorText: Bounces up, then down the next turn. May paralyze.

covet.name: covet
covet.flavorText: Cutely begs to obtain an item held by the foe.

water-pulse.name: water-pulse
water-pulse.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
water-pulse.flavorText: Attacks with ultrasonic waves. May confuse the foe

healing-wish.name: healing-wish
healing-wish.effect: User faints.  Its replacement has its HP fully restored and any major status effect removed.
healing-wish.flavorText: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

low-sweep.name: low-sweep
low-sweep.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
low-sweep.flavorText: The user attacks the target’s legs swiftly, reducing the target’s Speed stat.

entrainment.name: entrainment
entrainment.effect: Copies the user’s ability onto the target.
entrainment.flavorText: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s.

after-you.name: after-you
after-you.effect: Makes the target act next this turn.
after-you.flavorText: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

work-up.name: work-up
work-up.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.
work-up.flavorText: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

rototiller.name: rototiller
rototiller.effect: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all Grass Pokémon in battle.
rototiller.flavorText: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. This raises the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of Grass-type Pokémon.

baby-doll-eyes.name: baby-doll-eyes
baby-doll-eyes.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
baby-doll-eyes.flavorText: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers its Attack stat. This move always goes first.

tackle.name: tackle
tackle.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

leer.name: leer
leer.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

spark.name: spark
spark.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
spark.flavorText: An attack that may cause paralysis.

charge.name: charge
charge.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage.  User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.
charge.flavorText: Charges power to boost the electric move used next.

overheat.name: overheat
overheat.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
overheat.flavorText: Allows a full-power attack, but sharply lowers SP. ATK.

odor-sleuth.name: odor-sleuth
odor-sleuth.effect: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.
odor-sleuth.flavorText: Negates the foe’s efforts to heighten evasiveness.

howl.name: howl
howl.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
howl.flavorText: Howls to raise the spirit and boosts ATTACK.

magnet-rise.name: magnet-rise
magnet-rise.effect: User is immune to Ground moves and effects for five turns.
magnet-rise.flavorText: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

discharge.name: discharge
discharge.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
discharge.flavorText: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike all Pokémon in battle. It may also cause paralysis.

volt-switch.name: volt-switch
volt-switch.effect: User must switch out after attacking.
volt-switch.flavorText: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

wild-charge.name: wild-charge
wild-charge.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
wild-charge.flavorText: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It also damages the user a little.

snarl.name: snarl
snarl.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
snarl.flavorText: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target’s Sp. Atk stat decrease.

electric-terrain.name: electric-terrain
electric-terrain.effect: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power.
electric-terrain.flavorText: The user electrifies the ground under everyone’s feet for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

rock-blast.name: rock-blast
rock-blast.flavorText: Hurls boulders at the foe 2 to 5 times in a row.

hurricane.name: hurricane
hurricane.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
hurricane.flavorText: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the target.

meteor-beam.name: meteor-beam
meteor-beam.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
meteor-beam.flavorText: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat, then attacks the target on the next turn.

dual-wingbeat.name: dual-wingbeat
dual-wingbeat.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
dual-wingbeat.flavorText: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.

pay-day.name: pay-day
pay-day.effect: Scatters money on the ground worth five times the user’s level.
pay-day.flavorText: Throws coins. Gets them back later.

sand-attack.name: sand-attack
sand-attack.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

tail-whip.name: tail-whip
tail-whip.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

growl.name: growl
growl.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

thunder-shock.name: thunder-shock
thunder-shock.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder-shock.flavorText: An electrical attack that may paralyze the foe.

dig.name: dig
dig.effect: User digs underground, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

mud-slap.name: mud-slap
mud-slap.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

weather-ball.name: weather-ball
weather-ball.effect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.
weather-ball.flavorText: The move’s type and power change with the weather.

fake-tears.name: fake-tears
fake-tears.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
fake-tears.flavorText: Feigns crying to sharply lower the foe’s SP. DEF.

metal-sound.name: metal-sound
metal-sound.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
metal-sound.flavorText: Emits a horrible screech that sharply lowers SP. DEF.

copycat.name: copycat
copycat.effect: Uses the target’s last used move.
copycat.flavorText: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

electro-ball.name: electro-ball
electro-ball.effect: Power is higher when the user has greater Speed than the target, up to a maximum of 150.
electro-ball.flavorText: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the damage.

echoed-voice.name: echoed-voice
echoed-voice.effect: Power increases by 100% for each consecutive use by any friendly Pokémon, to a maximum of 200.
echoed-voice.flavorText: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

stored-power.name: stored-power
stored-power.effect: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
stored-power.flavorText: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the damage.

retaliate.name: retaliate
retaliate.effect: Has double power if a friendly Pokémon fainted last turn.
retaliate.flavorText: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack’s damage increases.

eerie-impulse.name: eerie-impulse
eerie-impulse.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.
eerie-impulse.flavorText: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

rising-voltage.name: rising-voltage
rising-voltage.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
rising-voltage.flavorText: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. This move's power doubles when the target is on Electric Terrain.

trailblaze.name: trailblaze
trailblaze.flavorText: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

alluring-voice.name: alluring-voice
alluring-voice.flavorText: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

hypnosis.name: hypnosis
hypnosis.flavorText: May put the foe to sleep.

lick.name: lick
lick.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
lick.flavorText: An attack that may cause paralysis.

explosion.name: explosion
explosion.flavorText: Very powerful but makes user faint.

nightmare.name: nightmare
nightmare.effect: Target loses 1/4 its max HP every turn as long as it’s asleep.
nightmare.flavorText: A sleeper loses 1/4 HP every turn.

spite.name: spite
spite.effect: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4.
spite.flavorText: Cuts the PP of the foe's last move.

destiny-bond.name: destiny-bond
destiny-bond.effect: If the user faints this turn, the target automatically will, too.
destiny-bond.flavorText: The foe faints if the user does.

icy-wind.name: icy-wind
icy-wind.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
icy-wind.flavorText: An icy attack that lowers SPEED.

mean-look.name: mean-look
mean-look.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

pain-split.name: pain-split
pain-split.effect: Sets the user’s and targets’s HP to the average of their current HP.
pain-split.flavorText: Adds user & foe's HPs. Shares total.

shadow-punch.name: shadow-punch
shadow-punch.flavorText: An unavoidable punch that is thrown from shadows.

dark-pulse.name: dark-pulse
dark-pulse.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
dark-pulse.flavorText: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

shadow-claw.name: shadow-claw
shadow-claw.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
shadow-claw.flavorText: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

mega-punch.name: mega-punch
mega-punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
mega-punch.flavorText: A powerful punch thrown very hard.

slam.name: slam
slam.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
slam.flavorText: Slams the foe with a tail, vine, etc.

mega-kick.name: mega-kick
mega-kick.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
mega-kick.flavorText: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

reversal.name: reversal
reversal.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
reversal.flavorText: Stronger if the user's HP is low.

encore.name: encore
encore.effect: Forces the target to repeat its last used move every turn for 2 to 6 turns.
encore.flavorText: Makes the foe re­ peat 2-6 times.

feint.name: feint
feint.flavorText: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

nasty-plot.name: nasty-plot
nasty-plot.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
nasty-plot.flavorText: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

disarming-voice.name: disarming-voice
disarming-voice.flavorText: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

draining-kiss.name: draining-kiss
draining-kiss.effect: Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.
draining-kiss.flavorText: The user steals the target’s energy with a kiss. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.

play-rough.name: play-rough
play-rough.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
play-rough.flavorText: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

play-nice.name: play-nice
play-nice.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
play-nice.flavorText: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.

nuzzle.name: nuzzle
nuzzle.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
nuzzle.flavorText: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

speed-swap.name: speed-swap
speed-swap.effect: Exchanges the user’s Speed with the target’s.
speed-swap.flavorText: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

upper-hand.name: upper-hand
upper-hand.flavorText: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

razor-wind.name: razor-wind
razor-wind.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.

ember.name: ember
ember.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
ember.flavorText: The foe is attacked with small flames. The foe may suffer a burn.

peck.name: peck
peck.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
peck.flavorText: Jabs the foe with a beak, etc.

fire-spin.name: fire-spin
fire-spin.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
fire-spin.flavorText: Traps foe in fire for 2-5 turns.

flail.name: flail
flail.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
flail.flavorText: Stronger if the user's HP is low.

feather-dance.name: feather-dance
feather-dance.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
feather-dance.flavorText: Envelops the foe with down to sharply reduce ATTACK.

air-cutter.name: air-cutter
air-cutter.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
air-cutter.flavorText: Hacks with razorlike wind. High critical-hit ratio.

bulk-up.name: bulk-up
bulk-up.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
bulk-up.flavorText: Bulks up the body to boost both ATTACK and DEFENSE.

natural-gift.name: natural-gift
natural-gift.effect: Power and type depend on the held berry.
natural-gift.flavorText: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

me-first.name: me-first
me-first.effect: Uses the target’s move against it before it attacks, with power increased by half.
me-first.flavorText: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.

flare-blitz.name: flare-blitz
flare-blitz.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.  Has a chance to burn the target.
flare-blitz.flavorText: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user sustains serious damage, too.

air-slash.name: air-slash
air-slash.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
air-slash.flavorText: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

brave-bird.name: brave-bird
brave-bird.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
brave-bird.flavorText: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

flame-charge.name: flame-charge
flame-charge.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.
flame-charge.flavorText: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user’s Speed stat.

temper-flare.name: temper-flare
temper-flare.flavorText: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

scratch.name: scratch
scratch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

screech.name: screech
screech.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

metronome.name: metronome
metronome.effect: Randomly selects and uses any move in the game.

slash.name: slash
slash.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
slash.flavorText: Has a high criti­ cal hit ratio.

metal-claw.name: metal-claw
metal-claw.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.
metal-claw.flavorText: An attack that may up user's ATTACK.

whirlpool.name: whirlpool
whirlpool.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.

hail.name: hail
hail.effect: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.
hail.flavorText: Summons a hailstorm that strikes every turn.

revenge.name: revenge
revenge.effect: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
revenge.flavorText: An attack that gains power if injured by the foe.

icicle-spear.name: icicle-spear
icicle-spear.flavorText: Attacks the foe by firing 2 to 5 icicles in a row.

punishment.name: punishment
punishment.effect: Power increases against targets with more raised stats, up to a maximum of 200.
punishment.flavorText: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.

night-slash.name: night-slash
night-slash.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
night-slash.flavorText: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

avalanche.name: avalanche
avalanche.effect: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
avalanche.flavorText: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

ice-shard.name: ice-shard
ice-shard.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
ice-shard.flavorText: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.

hone-claws.name: hone-claws
hone-claws.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.
hone-claws.flavorText: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

lash-out.name: lash-out
lash-out.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
lash-out.flavorText: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If its stats were lowered during the turn, the power of this move is doubled.

triple-axel.name: triple-axel
triple-axel.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
triple-axel.flavorText: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

ice-spinner.name: ice-spinner
ice-spinner.flavorText: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

snowscape.name: snowscape
snowscape.flavorText: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

chilling-water.name: chilling-water
chilling-water.flavorText: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

spikes.name: spikes
spikes.effect: Scatters Spikes, hurting opposing Pokémon that switch in.
spikes.flavorText: Hurts foes when they switch out.

bullet-seed.name: bullet-seed
bullet-seed.flavorText: Shoots 2 to 5 seeds in a row to strike the foe.

frenzy-plant.name: frenzy-plant
frenzy-plant.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
frenzy-plant.flavorText: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.

magical-leaf.name: magical-leaf
magical-leaf.flavorText: Attacks with a strange leaf that cannot be evaded.

worry-seed.name: worry-seed
worry-seed.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.
worry-seed.flavorText: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

aura-sphere.name: aura-sphere
aura-sphere.flavorText: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

seed-bomb.name: seed-bomb
seed-bomb.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
seed-bomb.flavorText: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

power-gem.name: power-gem
power-gem.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
power-gem.flavorText: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

leaf-storm.name: leaf-storm
leaf-storm.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
leaf-storm.flavorText: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

grass-pledge.name: grass-pledge
grass-pledge.effect: With Fire Pledge, damages opposing Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP every turn for four turns.
grass-pledge.flavorText: A column of grass hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its water equivalent, its damage increases into a vast swamp.

petal-blizzard.name: petal-blizzard
petal-blizzard.flavorText: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

grassy-terrain.name: grassy-terrain
grassy-terrain.effect: For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power.
grassy-terrain.flavorText: The user turns the ground under everyone’s feet to grass for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn.

leafage.name: leafage
leafage.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
leafage.flavorText: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

pollen-puff.name: pollen-puff
pollen-puff.effect: Damages opponents, but heals allies for 50% of their max HP.
pollen-puff.flavorText: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

grassy-glide.name: grassy-glide
grassy-glide.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

meditate.name: meditate

grass-whistle.name: grass-whistle

poison-sting.name: poison-sting

twin-beam.name: twin-beam
twin-beam.flavorText: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

triple-arrows.name: triple-arrows
triple-arrows.flavorText: The user delivers an axe kick, then fires three arrows. This raises the chance of its future attacks landing critical hits and also lowers the target's defensive stats.

shelter.name: shelter
shelter.flavorText: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, raising its defensive stats. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

instruct.name: instruct
instruct.effect: Forces the target to repeat its last used move.
instruct.flavorText: The user instructs the target to use the target’s last move again.

sparkling-aria.name: sparkling-aria
sparkling-aria.flavorText: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be healed by the touch of these bubbles.

beak-blast.name: beak-blast
beak-blast.effect: Inflicts a burn on any Pokémon that makes contact before the attack.
beak-blast.flavorText: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the Pokémon while it’s heating up its beak results in a burn.

headlong-rush.name: headlong-rush
headlong-rush.flavorText: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s defensive stats.

horn-leech.name: horn-leech
horn-leech.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
horn-leech.flavorText: The user drains the target’s energy with its horns. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

forests-curse.name: forests-curse
forests-curse.effect: Adds Grass to the target’s types.
forests-curse.flavorText: The user puts a forest curse on the target. Afflicted targets are now Grass type as well.

branch-poke.name: branch-poke
branch-poke.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
branch-poke.flavorText: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

zap-cannon.name: zap-cannon
zap-cannon.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

magnetic-flux.name: magnetic-flux
magnetic-flux.effect: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.
magnetic-flux.flavorText: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which raises the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.

magnitude.name: magnitude
magnitude.flavorText: A ground attack with random power.

dynamic-punch.name: dynamic-punch
dynamic-punch.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

secret-power.name: secret-power
secret-power.effect: Has a chance to inflict a status effect which depends upon the terrain.
secret-power.flavorText: An attack with effects that vary by location.

simple-beam.name: simple-beam
simple-beam.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Simple.
simple-beam.flavorText: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.

kowtow-cleave.name: kowtow-cleave
kowtow-cleave.flavorText: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

transform.name: transform
transform.effect: User becomes a copy of the target until it leaves battle.
transform.flavorText: The user assumes the foe's guise.

syrup-bomb.name: syrup-bomb
syrup-bomb.flavorText: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

fickle-beam.name: fickle-beam
fickle-beam.flavorText: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

ice-hammer.name: ice-hammer
ice-hammer.effect: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
ice-hammer.flavorText: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

spider-web.name: spider-web
spider-web.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

constrict.name: constrict
constrict.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
constrict.flavorText: An attack that may lower SPEED.

toxic-thread.name: toxic-thread
toxic-thread.effect: Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by one stage.
toxic-thread.flavorText: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target’s Speed stat.

rock-wrecker.name: rock-wrecker
rock-wrecker.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
rock-wrecker.flavorText: The user launches a huge boulder at the foe to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

guard-split.name: guard-split
guard-split.effect: Averages Defense and Special Defense with the target.
guard-split.flavorText: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target’s.

mountain-gale.name: mountain-gale
mountain-gale.flavorText: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage.

salt-cure.name: salt-cure
salt-cure.flavorText: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

baneful-bunker.name: baneful-bunker
baneful-bunker.effect: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn and poisons any Pokémon that tries to use a contact move on it.
baneful-bunker.flavorText: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.

snap-trap.name: snap-trap
snap-trap.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
snap-trap.flavorText: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.

camouflage.name: camouflage
camouflage.effect: User’s type changes to match the terrain.
camouflage.flavorText: Alters the POKéMON’s type depending on the location.

apple-acid.name: apple-acid
apple-acid.flavorText: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

shell-side-arm.name: shell-side-arm
shell-side-arm.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
shell-side-arm.flavorText: This move inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. This may also poison the target.

eerie-spell.name: eerie-spell
eerie-spell.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
eerie-spell.flavorText: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

chilly-reception.name: chilly-reception
chilly-reception.flavorText: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

magic-powder.name: magic-powder
magic-powder.flavorText: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target to Psychic type.

sharpen.name: sharpen
sharpen.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
sharpen.flavorText: A move that raises the user's ATTACK.

ice-ball.name: ice-ball
ice-ball.effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.
ice-ball.flavorText: A 5-turn attack that gains power on successive hits.
